thag16.6:1.1: Paripuṇṇakāyo suruci sujāto cārudassano suvaṇṇavaṇṇo 'si bhagavā, susukkadāṭho 'si viriyavā. || ||
thag16.6:2.1: narassa hi sujātassa ye bhavanti viyañjanā sabbe te tava kāyasmiṃ mahāpurisalakkhaṇā. || ||
thag16.6:3.1: pasannanetto sumukho brahā uju patāpavā majjhe samaṇasaṃghassa ādicco va virocasi. || ||
thag16.6:4.1: kalyāṇadassano bhikkhu kañcanasannibhattaco: kin te samaṇabhāvena evaṃ uttamavaṇṇino. || ||
thag16.6:5.1: rājā arahasi bhavituṃ cakkavattirathesabho cāturanto vijitāvī Jambusaṇḍassa issaro. || ||
thag16.6:6.1: khattiyā bhojarājāno anuyantā bhavanti te; rājābhirājā manujindo rajjaṃ kārehi Gotama. || ||
thag16.6:7.1: rājāham asmi Selā 'ti bhagavā dhammarājā anuttaro, dhammena cakkaṃ vattemi cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ. || ||
thag16.6:8.1: sambuddho paṭijānāsi iti Selo brāhmaṇo dhammarājā anuttaro, dhammena cakkaṃ vattemi iti bhāsasi Gotama. || ||
thag16.6:9.1: ko nu senāpatī bhoto sāvako satthur anvayo, ko imaṃ anuvatteti dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ. || ||
thag16.6:10.1: mayā pavattitaṃ cakkaṃ Selā 'ti bhagavā dhammacakkam anuttaraṃ Sāriputto 'nuvatteti anujāto tathāgataṃ. || ||
thag16.6:11.1: abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, bhāvetabbañ ca bhāvitaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddho 'smi brāhmaṇa. || ||
thag16.6:12.1: vinayassu mayī kaṅkhaṃ. adhimuccassu brāhmaṇa. dullabhaṃ dassanaṃ hoti sambuddhānaṃ abhiṇhaso. || ||
thag16.6:13.1: yesaṃ ve dullabho loke pātubhāvo abhiṇhaso, so 'haṃ brāhmaṇa buddho 'smi sallakatto anuttaro. || ||
thag16.6:14.1: Brahmabhūto atitulo Mārasenappamaddano sabbāmitte vasīkatvā modāmi akutobhayo. || ||
thag16.6:15.1: idaṃ bhonto nisāmetha yathā bhāsati cakkhumā sallakatto mahāvīro, sīho va nadatī vane. || ||
thag16.6:16.1: Brahmabhūtaṃ atitulaṃ Mārasenappamaddanaṃ ko disvā na ppasīdeyya api kaṇhābhijātiko. || ||
thag16.6:17.1: yo maṃ icchati anvetu yo vā n' icchati gacchatu: idhāhaṃ pabbajissāmi varapaññassa santike. || ||
thag16.6:18.1: etañ ce ruccatī bhoto sammāsambuddhasāsanaṃ, mayam pi pabbajissāma varapaññassa santike. || ||
thag16.6:19.1: brāhmaṇā tisatā ime yācanti pañjalīkatā: brahmacariyaṃ carissāma bhagavā tava santike. || ||
thag16.6:20.1: svākkhātaṃ brahmacariyaṃ Selā 'ti bhagavā sandiṭṭhikam akālikaṃ yattha amoghā pabbajjā appamattassa sikkhato. || ||
thag16.6:21.1: yan taṃ saraṇam āgamma ito aṭṭhami cakkhuma, sattarattena bhagavā dant' amha tava sāsane. || ||
thag16.6:22.1: tuvaṃ buddho, tuvaṃ satthā, tuvaṃ Mārābhibhū muni, tuvaṃ anusaye chetvā tiṇṇo tāres' imaṃ pajaṃ. || ||
thag16.6:23.1: upadhī te samatikkantā, āsavā te padālitā, sīho va anupādāno pahīnabhayabheravo. || ||
thag16.6:24.1: bhikkhavo tisatā ime tiṭṭhantī pañjalīkatā; pāde vīra pasārehi, nāgā vandantu satthuno 'ti. || || Selo thero.
